specification.title: GitHub-native lifecycle specification and evidence packet
specification.status: Approved by Joel for Phase 0 preservation; effective after merge to main.

notes: Rendering this manifest proposes one issue payload only. Creating the issue is an external write and is separately authorized.

This manifest carries GHL-013 alone. The v1 manifest remains the record for GHL-001 through GHL-010; those issues are already rendered, and retrofitting definition_of_done blocks onto merged work would invent contracts nobody agreed to.
Rendering is proposal-only and does not ratify. The coordinator refuses to claim a v2 issue until Joel posts a ratified-definition-of-done.v1 comment binding the rendered payload_sha256.

issues.title: Adopt the budgeted plain-terms lead block in packets and contributor doctrine
issues.summary: Every PR body, ready-for-joel packet, and report to Joel leads with a budgeted plain-English block so adjudication happens at the altitude where the owner's judgment is strongest. Doctrine amendment only; mandated by Joel 2026-07-27 (agent-scripts issue #18).
acceptance_criteria: Amend the contributor operating protocol so the packet contract requires an "In plain terms" lead block: three to five jargon-free sentences covering what changes in the world, what could go wrong, how undoable the change is, and the one thing to read if only one.

Amend the contribution review architecture with the plain-terms layer, its rationale, and its named failure modes: the plain layer must never replace the technical record, must inform rather than persuade, and must never omit what could go wrong.
State the proportionality rule: one-way-door decisions get the full decision-analysis.v1 treatment; small two-way doors get the minimum budget.
Record changelog entries in each amended document.
Keep the amendment documentation-only; no schema, validator, or renderer changes.
non_goals: No schema or validator enforcement of the block (a later issue graduates it into the packet schema and policy evaluator).
No GitHub writes by this issue's tooling.
No rewriting of already-merged PR bodies.

proof_requirements.requirement: docs/contributor-operating-protocol.md requires an "In plain terms" lead block on every packet, specified as three to five jargon-free sentences covering what changes in the world, what could go wrong, how undoable the change is, and the one thing to read if only one.
proof_requirements.evidence: The amended packet-contract section of docs/contributor-operating-protocol.md, quoted in the ready packet with the sentence-count and the four required subjects visible.

proof_requirements.requirement: docs/contribution-review-architecture.md documents the plain-terms layer with its rationale and its three named failure modes: it must never replace the technical record, must inform rather than persuade, and must never omit what could go wrong.
proof_requirements.evidence: The amended layer section of docs/contribution-review-architecture.md, quoted in the ready packet with all three failure modes named.

proof_requirements.requirement: Both amended documents state the proportionality rule: a one-way-door decision gets the full decision-analysis.v1 treatment, and a small two-way door gets the minimum budget.
proof_requirements.evidence: The proportionality sentence quoted from each of the two documents, showing both the one-way-door and two-way-door halves.

proof_requirements.requirement: Each amended document records a changelog entry for this amendment.
proof_requirements.evidence: The changelog entry from each of the two documents, each naming GHL-013.

proof_requirements.requirement: The change edits documentation only and touches no schema, validator, or renderer file.
proof_requirements.evidence: git diff --name-only against the base commit listing only paths under docs/, together with a passing npm run agent:check.

pass_criteria.criterion: The packet contract names the lead block, bounds it at three to five sentences, and enumerates the four required subjects.
pass_criteria.expected_result: All four subjects appear in the contract text and the sentence bound is stated numerically; a contract missing any subject or the bound fails.

pass_criteria.criterion: The architecture document names the plain-terms layer and all three failure modes.
pass_criteria.expected_result: Three failure modes appear as explicit prohibitions; fewer than three fails.

pass_criteria.criterion: The proportionality rule appears in both documents and distinguishes one-way from two-way doors.
pass_criteria.expected_result: Both documents state the rule with both halves; the rule appearing in only one document fails.

pass_criteria.criterion: Both amended documents carry a changelog entry referencing GHL-013.
pass_criteria.expected_result: Two changelog entries exist, each naming GHL-013; one entry or an unreferenced entry fails.

pass_criteria.criterion: The diff touches only documentation paths and the repository gate passes.
pass_criteria.expected_result: git diff --name-only lists only docs/ paths and npm run agent:check exits 0; any non-docs path fails.

non_goals: No schema or validator enforcement of the block (a later issue graduates it into the packet schema and policy evaluator).
No GitHub writes by this issue's tooling.
No rewriting of already-merged PR bodies.

kill_criteria.trigger: A second review round still reports a contract gap in the packet contract.
kill_criteria.action: Stop and escalate to Joel with the specific gap named; do not open a third round.
kill_criteria.decide_by: Before a third review round is dispatched.

kill_criteria.trigger: The amendment cannot be made coherent without editing a schema, validator, or renderer file.
kill_criteria.action: Stop; the work has outgrown a documentation-only issue and needs a new issue with a wider write class.
kill_criteria.decide_by: Within the same mission, before any non-documentation file is edited.

defer_policy.destination: A new GHL issue proposed through this manifest, carrying the deferred finding verbatim.
defer_policy.promotion_rule: A deferred finding is promoted into scope only when Joel names it in a GitHub comment on this issue or its pull request; a reviewer cannot promote its own finding.
